changes.new: ChmDocument.ToMarkdown(ChmMarkdownExportOptions options[, out OfficeConversionReport report], CancellationToken) : MarkdownDocument; ToMarkdownAsync; SaveAsMarkdown(path | stream); SaveAsMarkdownAsync
changes.reason: Converters use the shared shape: To{Target}(options[, out OfficeConversionReport], ct), To{Target}Async returning OfficeConversionResult<T>, and SaveAs{Target}(path | stream) returning OfficeConversionReport. Result, Bytes and Stream twins are removed.
changes.replacement: Call ToMarkdown() on the returned MarkdownDocument for text, or SaveAsMarkdown for a file.

changes.reason: Converter options are named {Source}{Target}ExportOptions and carry FailOnLoss.
